code.why: Host-process serve factory: the life and examples use the fetch in an in-memory World; conformance separately drives the real server and boot probe.

A row observed from a live workspace by a GraphQL refresh carries its parent's vendor id, not the World's _org index: only a vendor-backed World's observations reach it. The simulated life and the examples write the index.

The World's app-credentials door asked again for an application it already made, with new callback URLs: the edit a person makes to an OAuth application in Linear's settings, which no API call makes. The life's application asks the door once by its name. https://linear.app/developers/oauth-2-0-authentication
